papers.title: Learning to Trace Seiberg Dualities
papers.abstract: Dualities play an important role in establishing both microscopic and emergent phenomena in a wide range of physical systems. In practice, though, it can often be computationally challenging to establish when two systems are dual, even when all of the "rules of the game" are well-known. Said differently, when confronted with two systems, how can one efficiently establish that they are in fact dual? In this paper we use machine learning methods to address this question for Seiberg dualities of supersymmetric quiver gauge theories. Mathematically, this involves establishing mutations of quivers, which is in turn a variation on the theme of "learning to unknot". On the one hand, this leads us to a practical tool for establishing the computational complexity of different dualities. On the other hand, it also allows us to study how different network architectures learn how to trace Seiberg dualities. We find that for quivers with a modest number of quiver nodes (of order $10$), different network architectures consisting of transformers and multi-layer perceptrons tend to outperform deterministic algorithms. Supplementing the network by well-established pathfinder algorithms (essentially "Google Maps for quivers") leads to an additional improvement in the efficiency and accuracy of the search strategy. We anticipate that this class of questions can serve as a useful benchmark for frontier AI models applied to theoretical physics.
papers.summary_zh: 论文研究如何用机器学习高效判定超对称quiver规范理论的Seiberg对偶性，即quiver突变问题。方法上采用Transformer和MLP等网络架构学习quiver突变，并引入路径查找算法辅助搜索。结果表明，对于约10个节点的quiver，神经网络优于确定性算法，且混合策略进一步提升效率与准确性。
papers.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational challenge of establishing Seiberg dualities in supersymmetric quiver gauge theories, framed as quiver mutation problems. The authors employ machine learning models, including transformers and MLPs, to learn these mutations, supplemented by pathfinder algorithms for improved search. Results show that for quivers with ~10 nodes, neural architectures outperform deterministic algorithms, and hybrid approaches further enhance efficiency and accuracy.
highlights_zh: 用ML学习quiver突变判定对偶性
约10节点时神经网络优于传统算法
可作为AI物理基准测试任务

papers.title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
papers.abstract: Long visual context poses a challenge for vision-language models: performance degrades as the number of distractors grows, and processing all tokens at once is computationally infeasible under GPU memory constraints. We present ReToken, a single learnable embedding trained as an explicit retrieval target that selects a sparse set of query-relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled visual KV cache. Trained on only a small image-QA dataset, ReToken yields consistent gains across image and video benchmarks: on Visual Haystacks it improves Qwen3VL-8B by 13.4 points and InternVL3.5 by 12.4 points (>20% relative), and on LVBench it transfers zero-shot to long video for an 8.0-point gain with Qwen3VL-8B. Thanks to its lightweight design, both training and long-video inference fit on a single H100. Code is available at: https://github.com/avaxiao/ReToken
papers.summary_zh: 长视觉上下文中，视觉语言模型性能随干扰物增多而下降，且全量token处理受GPU内存限制。ReToken提出一个可学习的检索目标嵌入，从预填充的视觉KV缓存中稀疏选择查询相关token，仅需小规模图像QA数据集训练。在Visual Haystacks上Qwen3VL-8B提升13.4点，LVBench零样本长视频提升8.0点，训练和推理均可在单张H100上完成。
papers.summary_en: Long visual context degrades vision-language model performance as distractors increase, and processing all tokens is infeasible under GPU memory limits. ReToken introduces a single learnable embedding as an explicit retrieval target to sparsely select query-relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled KV cache, trained on only a small image-QA dataset. It achieves consistent gains (e.g., +13.4 on Visual Haystacks for Qwen3VL-8B, +8.0 zero-shot on LVBench) with lightweight training and inference on a single H100.
highlights_zh: 单可学习token稀疏检索视觉token
VH上Qwen3VL-8B提升13.4点
单H100可训练与长视频推理

papers.title: KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models
papers.abstract: Clinical risk models routinely achieve strong aggregate performance while producing materially different error rates across patient subgroups. Audit pipelines have been proposed to catch this, but their components are rarely stress-tested, so it is unclear which parts of an audit can be trusted and under what conditions. We present KAISEN, a five-phase audit pipeline covering subgroup stratification, disparity measurement, mechanism diagnostics, post-hoc mitigation, and drift monitoring, evaluated to the point of failure on a synthetic benchmark of 16 disease tasks, 15 social-determinant axes from Healthy People 2030, and three prespecified intersections. Four findings follow. (i) Significance tracks each axis's gap against its own minimum detectable effect: rank correlation between significance count and raw equalized-odds difference (EOD) across the 15 axes is rho = 0.56, rising to rho = 0.78 once EOD is standardized by that floor. (ii) Per-group threshold optimization reduces EOD in 48 of 48 held-out runs (paired delta = -0.285, 95% CI [-0.313, -0.252]), while group-wise Platt scaling -- the better calibrator -- behaves as a coin flip on EOD (19 of 48 runs improved, 95% CI [0.26, 0.55]) with mean effect near zero, so what an audit should report is the variance, not the average. (iii) The mechanism diagnostic classifies 144 of 144 controlled cases correctly but recovers none of 48 model-driven cases under proxy misspecification, with no signal that it failed. (iv) CUSUM failures and false alarms track cohort realization far more than disease: at the reference threshold, all 27 false alarms and 7 of 8 missed shifts come from different seeds (chi-squared p = 0.002), so a threshold tuned on one cohort fails to transfer. All results are synthetic with known ground truth and do not establish clinical validity. Code, artifacts, and scripts reproducing every number are released.
papers.summary_zh: 临床风险模型在总体表现良好时，常在不同患者亚组间产生显著差异的错误率，而现有审计流程的各组件缺乏压力测试，可信度不明。KAISEN提出了一个五阶段审计流水线，涵盖亚组分层、差异度量、机制诊断、事后缓解和漂移监测，并在包含16种疾病任务、15个社会决定因素轴和3个预设交集的合成基准上进行了彻底的失败点评估。研究发现显著性受最小可检测效应影响、阈值优化稳定降低EOD而Platt缩放效果如抛硬币、机制诊断在代理误设下完全失效且无失败信号、CUSUM阈值无法跨队列迁移，强调了审计中报告方差而非平均值的重要性。
papers.summary_en: Clinical risk models often show strong aggregate performance but materially different error rates across patient subgroups, while existing audit pipelines lack stress-testing of their components. KAISEN introduces a five-phase audit pipeline covering subgroup stratification, disparity measurement, mechanism diagnostics, post-hoc mitigation, and drift monitoring, evaluated to the point of failure on a synthetic benchmark of 16 disease tasks, 15 social-determinant axes, and three intersections. Key findings reveal that significance tracks minimum detectable effects, threshold optimization reliably reduces EOD while Platt scaling behaves like a coin flip, mechanism diagnostics fail silently under proxy misspecification, and CUSUM thresholds do not transfer across cohorts, underscoring the need to report variance rather than averages.
highlights_zh: 五阶段审计流水线至失败点评估
阈值优化48/48降低EOD，Platt无效
机制诊断代理误设下完全失效

papers.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
papers.abstract: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.
papers.summary_zh: 商业AI产品的系统提示词很少公开，导致信任与问责缺口。本文提出AISPA框架，从八个维度系统审计系统提示词，并审查了88个商业产品中的3249条指令。审计发现保护性指令普遍但深度不足，约40%产品存在有害指令，凸显了提高透明度与标准化监管的必要性。
papers.summary_en: System prompts in commercial AI products are rarely disclosed, creating a trust and accountability gap. This paper introduces AISPA, a user-centric framework auditing system prompts across eight dimensions, and applies it to 3,249 instructions from 88 products. The audit reveals protective instructions are widespread but shallow, while ~40% of products contain problematic instructions, highlighting the need for transparency and oversight.
highlights_zh: 首个用户中心系统提示词审计框架
88个产品3249条指令系统审计
揭示保护与有害指令共存现状

papers.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
papers.abstract: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60% lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/.
papers.summary_zh: 计算机智能体（CUA）的轨迹验证依赖VLM裁判，但其可靠性从未被系统检验。本文提出OSReward基准及OSReward-Hard/Multi，通过多阶段人工标注构建高质量测试集，并训练开源奖励模型OS-Shepherd。研究发现现有VLM裁判普遍存在宽松偏差，而OS-Shepherd以更低成本达到商业模型水平，为CUA奖励模型标准化评估奠定基础。
papers.summary_en: Verifying computer-using agent (CUA) trajectories increasingly relies on VLM judges, yet their reliability remains unexamined. We introduce OSReward, a rigorous benchmark with human-verified labels, plus OSReward-Hard/Multi, and train open reward models OS-Shepherd. Results show current judges share a leniency bias, while OS-Shepherd matches commercial performance at 30-60% lower cost, enabling scalable reliable CUA evaluation.
highlights_zh: 首个CUA裁判可靠性基准
OS-Shepherd降本30-60%
揭示VLM裁判宽松偏差

papers.title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence faces a fundamental data bottleneck. Models must capture how first-person perception, whole-body motion, dexterous manipulation, object state, sound, and touch evolve together as humans pursue goals over time. Existing datasets fragment this experience across viewpoints, modalities, or spatial scales, leaving the full perception-action loop only partially observed. We introduce the Ambient Capture Engine (ACE), a human-centric data engine that transforms real home environments into spatially calibrated, temporally synchronized recording studios. ACE operates at two complementary scales: a table-scale configuration resolves hand-object manipulation, while a room-scale configuration captures whole-body motion, locomotion, and interactions across a furnished home. ACE records egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, full-body and articulated hand motion, object geometry and 6-DoF trajectories, audio, and tactile signals as a unified multisensory stream. Using ACE, we build ACE-Data-0, comprising 150 hours and 17M video frames across 200 task categories, performed by 50 participants in 2 environments, for a total of 75,000 interaction episodes. The dataset spans atomic manipulation, long-horizon chains of household activities, and human-scene interaction, while preserving natural behavioral variation through goal-level rather than step-by-step instructions. We further introduce a hierarchical benchmark that progresses from signals to scene components and then to interactions. Evaluations of state-of-the-art methods expose substantial gaps under contact, occlusion, egomotion, and long temporal horizons. ACE-Data-0 provides synchronized human demonstrations with aligned perceptual, kinematic, and contact supervision, offering a scalable foundation for imitation learning, world models, vision-language-action systems, and embodied AI.
papers.summary_zh: 具身智能面临数据瓶颈，现有数据集在多模态、多尺度上碎片化，无法完整捕捉感知-行动闭环。本文提出ACE数据引擎，将真实家庭环境转化为时空校准的同步录制工作室，以桌面和房间双尺度采集统一的多感官数据流，构建了包含150小时、7.5万交互片段的ACE-Data-0数据集。该数据集支持从信号到场景组件再到交互的分层基准测试，揭示了现有方法在接触、遮挡、自我运动和长时程任务中的显著不足，为模仿学习、世界模型和VLA系统提供可扩展基础。
papers.summary_en: Embodied intelligence faces a data bottleneck as existing datasets fragment first-person perception, motion, manipulation, and contact across viewpoints and scales. We introduce the Ambient Capture Engine (ACE), a human-centric data engine that transforms real homes into spatially calibrated, temporally synchronized studios, producing ACE-Data-0 with 150 hours and 75,000 episodes across two scales. A hierarchical benchmark reveals substantial gaps in state-of-the-art methods under contact, occlusion, egomotion, and long horizons, offering a scalable foundation for imitation learning, world models, and embodied AI.
highlights_zh: 双尺度同步多模态数据采集
150小时/7.5万交互片段数据集
分层基准揭示接触与长时程短板

papers.title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
papers.abstract: We introduce PhiZero, a physical world model built around physical language, a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions. Existing physical world models typically predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving the underlying world dynamics implicit within high-dimensional visual predictors. Motivated by humans' ability to abstract predictive structure from visual experience and organize it in natural language for explicit reasoning, we learn physical language from in-the-wild videos through self-supervision and use it to explicitly reason about how the physical world evolves. Accordingly, PhiZero adopts a reason-then-render paradigm: it first infers future world evolution as a physical-language sequence and then renders the inferred transitions into videos. Extensive experiments across generation and understanding benchmarks validate the ability of PhiZero to model physically coherent world evolution. We further show its potential for realistic and interactive world modeling, fine-grained action-conditioned simulation, and zero-shot motion transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 现有物理世界模型直接在像素空间预测视频，隐含了世界动态，缺乏显式推理能力。PhiZero提出“物理语言”这一紧凑离散表示，通过自监督从视频中学习，并采用“先推理后渲染”范式，先推断物理语言序列再生成视频。实验证明其在生成和理解基准上能建模物理一致的世界演化，并支持交互式建模、动作条件模拟和零样本运动迁移。
papers.summary_en: Existing physical world models predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving world dynamics implicit. PhiZero introduces 'physical language', a compact discrete representation learned via self-supervision from videos, and adopts a reason-then-render paradigm that first infers future evolution as a physical-language sequence then renders it into videos. Experiments show it models physically coherent world evolution, with potential for interactive modeling, fine-grained action-conditioned simulation, and zero-shot motion transfer.
highlights_zh: 提出物理语言离散表示
生成与理解基准均验证有效性
支持交互模拟与零样本迁移

papers.title: FA-RDP: A Frequency-Adaptive Reactive Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: In contact-rich manipulation, action multimodality and reactivity dominate different stages of a single episode. Before contact, multiple trajectories might be equally valid, making it important to preserve diverse action modes. After contact, geometric constraints and force limits narrow the solution space, while successful execution demands rapid responses to force feedback. However, standard diffusion policies use a fixed inference frequency and sampling steps throughout the episode, forcing a fundamental compromise: low-frequency, multi-step sampling better preserves pre-contact multimodality but responds slowly to force feedback, whereas high-frequency sampling improves reactivity but tends to collapse distinct pre-contact modes. To resolve this tradeoff, we present FA-RDP, a frequency-adaptive reactive diffusion policy. A shared multi-frequency visual-force Transformer predicts action chunks at both low and high frequencies, while a learned multimodality indicator dynamically selects multi-step low-frequency sampling before contact and one-step high-frequency sampling as action ambiguity decreases. We further introduce Manifold Consistency Distillation (MCD), which reparameterizes the diffusion network to predict actions on the robot action manifold while retaining DDPM-based residual supervision. Experiments on three contact-rich manipulation tasks show that FA-RDP achieves the highest success rate while preserving diverse pre-contact trajectory modes. Code and videos are available at https://fa-rdp.github.io.
papers.summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作任务中，动作多模态性和反应性在不同阶段主导，但标准扩散策略因固定推理频率和采样步数而难以兼顾两者。本文提出FA-RDP，通过共享多频视觉-力Transformer预测动作块，并利用学习的多模态指示器动态选择接触前的低频多步采样和接触后的高频单步采样，同时引入流形一致性蒸馏（MCD）将扩散网络重参数化以在机器人动作流形上预测动作。实验表明FA-RDP在三个接触丰富任务中取得最高成功率，同时保留接触前的多样化轨迹模式。
papers.summary_en: Contact-rich manipulation requires balancing action multimodality before contact and reactivity after contact, but standard diffusion policies with fixed inference frequency and sampling steps cannot achieve both. FA-RDP introduces a shared multi-frequency visual-force Transformer with a learned multimodality indicator to dynamically switch between low-frequency multi-step sampling before contact and high-frequency one-step sampling after contact, plus Manifold Consistency Distillation (MCD) for action prediction on the robot manifold. Experiments on three contact-rich tasks show FA-RDP achieves the highest success rate while preserving diverse pre-contact trajectory modes.
highlights_zh: 频率自适应动态切换采样策略
最高成功率且保留多模态轨迹
适用于接触丰富操作任务

papers.title: X-NavDP: Generalizing Navigation Diffusion Policy to Novel Behavior and Embodiments with Group Q-score Reweighted Matching
papers.abstract: Pretraining navigation diffusion policies rely on large-scale expert demonstrations. These data are typically generated by a fully-informed oracle planner suited to a single nominal robot. This limits the policy's generalization to diverse embodiments and challenging scenarios (e.g., escaping dead ends or detouring long obstacles) that demand diverse local reactive behaviors with only onboard local observations. Post-training the policy with reinforcement learning (RL) offers a principled remedy. However, previous RL for diffusion approaches lead to only marginal improvements. This is because the intractable likelihood of diffusion policies renders policy gradients unstable in addition to inefficient policy exploration. To address these challenges, we propose a data-efficient diffusion RL post-training framework - GQRM (Group Q-score Reweighted Matching). Our framework introduces two complementary designs: (i) a self-bootstrapped exploration strategy with behavior perturbation that preserves the pretrained policy prior, and (ii) a group Q-score normalization mechanism that computes per-trajectory values on each state for efficient reweighted score matching. By conducting distributed online RL training across heterogeneous embodiments, the resulting fine-tuned policy, X-NavDP, achieves state-of-the-art cross-embodiment visual navigation performance, improving the overall success rate from 61.20% to 84.28% in simulation and 10% to 65% in real-world hard cases. The code and model are publicly available at https://yty-sky.github.io/x-navdp-project-page.
papers.summary_zh: 预训练导航扩散策略依赖大规模专家数据，且通常针对单一机器人，导致在多样化形态和复杂场景下泛化能力受限，而现有强化学习后训练方法因扩散策略似然不可解导致梯度不稳定和探索低效。本文提出GQRM框架，通过自举探索策略保留预训练先验，并引入组Q分数归一化机制实现高效重加权分数匹配，从而数据高效地微调扩散策略。微调后的X-NavDP策略在跨形态视觉导航中取得显著提升，模拟环境成功率从61.20%提升至84.28%，真实世界困难场景从10%提升至65%。
papers.summary_enh: Pretrained navigation diffusion policies rely on large-scale expert data from a single nominal robot, limiting generalization to diverse embodiments and challenging scenarios, while prior RL post-training methods suffer from unstable gradients and inefficient exploration due to intractable diffusion likelihoods. We propose GQRM, a data-efficient diffusion RL post-training framework featuring self-bootstrapped exploration with behavior perturbation and group Q-score normalization for per-trajectory reweighted score matching. The resulting X-NavDP policy achieves state-of-the-art cross-embodiment navigation, improving success rates from 61.20% to 84.28% in simulation and from 10% to 65% in real-world hard cases.
highlights_zh: 组Q分数重加权匹配
跨形态导航泛化

papers.title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
papers.abstract: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. We evaluate on a controlled any-link contact benchmark with seeded throws in two regimes: single throws and a deployment loop in which the robot walks back to its station and recovers between throws. On this benchmark, the policy comes within a few points of a privileged state oracle: a fixed onboard camera alone is adequate for evasion. We find that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability: Joint-CBF gives the best performance with accurate ball states, degrades under fixed-camera observations when used only as training guidance, and recovers with a ball-tracking gimbal or privileged runtime filter. We therefore deploy a lightweight Link-CBF policy zero-shot on the Unitree G1 in the real world, where it tolerates imperfect perception, succeeds on 95% of throws, and uses semantic segmentation to dodge different balls.
papers.summary_zh: 人形机器人躲避球任务中，现有安全控制方法依赖理想化感知，难以应对真实部署中不完美的机载视觉。本文提出PAC-MAN框架，将控制屏障函数（CBF）安全约束与强化学习结合，训练时利用全身链接的CBF引导，部署时仅使用头戴相机的分割掩码深度图像，并引入对抗运动先验增强躲避反射。在仿真基准上性能接近特权状态预言机，并在真实Unitree G1机器人上零样本部署，实现95%躲避成功率，验证了感知感知安全策略的实用性与鲁棒性。
papers.summary_eng: Humanoid dodgeball requires whole-body safety under imperfect onboard perception, yet existing CBF-based controllers assume privileged state access. We propose PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples barrier safety with deployment-realistic sensing, using segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera at test time while training-time CBF guidance provides clearance to every body link. The policy approaches a privileged oracle's performance in simulation and achieves 95% real-world dodge success on the Unitree G1, demonstrating that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability and that lightweight Link-CBF policies transfer zero-shot.
highlights_zh: 感知感知CBF-RL框架
95%真实世界躲避成功率
依赖感知可观测性，需权衡
